chapter.verse: Tua ciangin vantung a thak khat leh leitung a thak khat ka mu hi. A hang pen vantung masa leh leitung masa maimang khinzo a, tuipi zong om nawnlo hi.
Tua ciangin a pasal' adinga a kizem mo nungak khat bangin khuapi siangtho ahi Jerusalem thak, Pasian' kiang vantung pan hong tungsuk ka mu hi.

Kumpi-tokhom panin awging lianpi khat ka za a, hih bangin ci hi: “En in, mite' lakah Pasian' puanbuk hong om hi. Pasian in mite' lakah phualsat ding a, mite pen ama' mipawl hong hiding uh hi. Pasian mahmah amaute' lakah hong om ding a, amaute' Pasian hong hiding hi.
Amaute' mit pana luang khitui khempeuh nulsiangsak ding a, sihna zong om nawnlo-in tauna, kahna leh gimthuakna zong om nawnlo ding hi. A hang pen a omsa thute maimang khinta hi.”
Tua ciangin kumpi-tokhom tunga a tu pen in, “En in, na khempeuh a thakin ka bawl hi,” ci hi. Tua banah, “Hih thu gelh in. A hang pen hih thute muantaakin thumaan ahi hi,” hong ci hi.
Hih bangin zong hong ci hi, “Man ta hi! Kei pen Alpha leh Omega, a kipatna leh a tawpna ka hi hi. A dangtakte' tungah nuntakna tuinak pana tui a khawnkhongin ka pia ding hi.
A gualzo mi in hihte luah ding a, kei pen ama' Pasian, amah pen keima' ta, hiding hi.

Ahi zongin meidawite, a muanhuailo mite, a muhthadahhuai mite, tualthatte, nulepa tatkhialhna a bawlte, aitawite, milim biate leh zuauphuak teng khempeuh ahihleh amau' ngah sehtan pen kaat tawh a kuang meili sung hiding a, tua pen sih nihna ahi hi.”
Tua ciangin a nunungbel gimpina sagihte tawh a kidim kuang-uk sagihte a nei vanmi sagihte' lakah khat in hong hopih a, “Hong pai in, Tuuno' zi ahi Mo Nungak kong lak ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin mual sang lianpi khat ah Kha tawh hong paikhiatpih a, Pasian' kiang vantung pana hong tungsuk khuapi siangtho Jerusalem hong lak hi.
Tua khuapi pen Pasian' vang tawh kidim a, a vangtaang zong a siang silsel, a te kelkel jasper suangmanpha tawh kibang hi.
Tua khuapi in kongvang sawmlenih a kithuah kulh a sang a golpi khat nei a, tua kulh kongvangte ah vanmi sawmlenih omin kongvangte' tungah Israel' tate beh sawmlenihte' min teng a kuakin kigelh hi.
Kulh kongvang pen nisuahlam ah thum, leilulam ah thum, leitawlam ah thum, nitumlam ah thum, om hi.
Khuapi kulh in khuambul suangtum sawmlenih nei a, tuate tungah Tuuno' sawltakpi sawmlenihte' min teng tuang hi.
Kei hong hopih pen in khuapi hitaleh, kulh kongvangte leh a kulhte hitaleh, a teh nadingin kham ciangtawn khat nei hi.
Khuapi pen kiuli-pangli kikim khawka nam hi a, a dung leh a vai kikim hi. Vanmi in a ciangtawn tawh khuapi teh a, tai 1,400 kiim pha hi. A sauna, a zaina, a sanna, a vekin a kikim ahi hi.
Kulh zong teh a, vanmi' tehna nam zong ahi pah, mihing' tehna nam tawh tong 144 sah hi.
Kulh pen jasper a kiciang hi a, khuapi ahihleh kham ci-tak tawh kibawlin limlang bangin siang kilkel hi.
Khuapi kulh khuambulte pen suangmanpha a namkim tawh kizem hi. Khatna ah jasper, nihna ah sapphire, thumna ah agate, lina ah amerald,
ngana ah onyx, gukna ah carnelian, sagihna ah chrysolite, giatna ah beryl, kuana ah topaz, sawmna ah chrysprase, sawmlekhatna ah jacinth leh sawmlenihna ah amethyst ahi hi.
Kulh kongvang sawmlenihte pen kep pekpi sawmlenih hi a, kongvang khat ciat pen kep pekpi khatta tawh a kibawl ahi hi. Khuapi sung lampi pen kham ci-tak tawh kibawl a, limlang bangin siang kilkel hi.
Khuapi sungah biakinn ka mu kei hi. Vanglian Topa Pasian leh Tuuno pen khuapi biakinn ahi hi.
Khuapi in khuavak a taangsak dingin ni ahi-a kha ahi zong kisam lo hi. A hang pen Pasian' minphatna vang in khuavak pia a, khuapi' meivak pen Tuuno ahi hi.
Tua khuavak tawh minamte lampai ding uh a, leitung kumpite in amau' minphatnate tua khuapi sung hong tunpih ding uh hi.
Kulh kongvangte sun hunin kikhak ngeilo ding a, tua mun ah zan cih bang om lo ding hi.
Minamte in khuapi sungah amau' minphatna leh pahtawina hong tunpih ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin a thanghuai, a muhthadahhuai leh zuau gamtat a kici peuhmah khuapi sung lut theilo ding a, Tuuno' nuntakna laibu sunga a kigelh mite bek lut thei ding uh hi.
